name: agent-fs-per-path-permission
body:
Law (prose; assessed by review): the fs tools (`apg_rm` / `apg_mv` / `apg_cp`) SELF-ENFORCE per-path scope. Each tool resolves the target path against the caller's project directory and REFUSES any path not matched by the acting agent's own granted path globs, which the tool reads from the caller's agent permission block (via the opencode plugin context). The tool-level grant is only the tool's CALLABILITY gate; per-path scoping lives INSIDE the tool, never in opencode's matching of a custom tool's path argument.

Acceptance: a generated implementer's permission block grants `apg_rm` / `apg_mv` / `apg_cp` deny-by-default — never a scalar `: allow`, and never a blanket `"*": allow` — with every allow entry mirrored under `apg/.worktrees/*/`. The tool refuses a path outside the acting agent's granted globs. How the tool learns which agent is acting (e.g. the plugin context's agent field) is an implementation concern for the plan; the enforcement requirement — the tool refuses an out-of-scope path — is what this law fixes.
